summary:
Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 15 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added two docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased/Added. Changes are additive only (777 insertions, 0 deletions); nothing was committed. Nothing was executed: tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the constraints, so the code is verified by reading only.

Deviations and judgment calls to review: (1) _Reader has added name and mode properties delegating to the handle, because typing.IO declares them abstract and Python 3.6 would otherwise fail to instantiate the reader. (2) The context wrapper is typed with Any, so I did not add the return-value/type-var suppression on module-level open; add it if mypy flags that line. (3) Progress.open is overloaded on 'r'/'rt' and 'rb'; module-level open types mode as the three typed literals. (4) With an explicit total and a missing path, Progress.open creates the task before the open fails, following the spec's step order, which leaves an orphaned task.
